content.short: SODAX is a cross-network execution and liquidity system for complex multi-chain flows.
content.description: SODAX provides cross-network execution and liquidity so applications can support flows spanning several chains without building the routing themselves, and operates on Hyperliquid. Execution across chains is harder than moving tokens, because a multi-step route can fail partway and leave a user holding an intermediate asset on the wrong network.
